description: What a Hyperliquid paper box and its strategies really did: strategy started, decisions with their reasons, orders, fills, funding, stops, plus equity, PnL, fees and positions. Call it with no after for the latest events, then pass next_cursor as after. gap true means some events were missed. Needs only the box URL.

box.description: The paper box: its base_url from create_ironbox, or the ibxs_ secret

name: get_box_activity

data_gap_seconds.description: Seconds it held something on a market with no live data

positions.description: Open positions: coin, szi, entry_px, unrealized_pnl, leverage

kind.description: strategy_started, decision, order, fill, funding, strategy_stopped or liquidated

strategy_id.description: Set on what a strategy did

expires_at.description: When a trial box ends at the latest, Unix milliseconds

gap.description: True when events between your cursor and the first returned are gone

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

title: Watch a paper box
